definition.question: How intense is escalation by Iran-linked proxies (Houthis, Hezbollah, Iraqi militias) across the region?
definition.low_end: Proxy networks dormant with no attacks on shipping or neighbors, and full compliance with disarmament and de-escalation agreements.
definition.high_end: Coordinated full-scale proxy war with sustained Houthi/Hezbollah/Iraqi militia attacks on shipping, Gulf infrastructure and Israel, triggering major retaliation.

readings.rationale: Houthis declared an immediate naval blockade on Saudi Arabia with 'eye for an eye' and 'all escalation' language, Saudi coalition mobilized anti-piracy measures, and a drone attack shut Saudi's 7m b/d East-West pipeline until Sept 22; Hezbollah rejected disarmament and pilot/safe zones while Lebanese Army began limited deployments in three southern villages. Higher if Houthis actually interdict…
